name: Two-way weighted kNN (analog engine)
kind: Unsupervised weighted k-nearest-neighbour on relief (Moon: 100 m, Mars: 500 m), two-way matching
trained_on: Copernicus GLO-30 + ESA WorldCover 2021 (+ MODIS MOD11A2 for thermal) vs LOLA LDEM_80S_20M (+ Diviner for thermal) for the Moon and MGS MOLA 463 m for Mars; 141 Earth sites; no labels
inputs: Moon: 5 km squares at 100 m pixels; Mars: 20 km squares at 500 m pixels (MOLA's resolution). Slope, steep share, roughness, crater-like dips; mission weights; no absolute elevation
limits: Sparse: 141 sites of 78,993 cells; unscored cells are 'not analysed', never 0. Candidates whose every square breaks a land-cover limit (forest, crops, water) were rejected and are not exported. ~30 cm rocks invisible at 100 m (Moon) or 500 m (Mars). Only 5-6 NASA sites per world to validate on: checks show the ranking is sensible, not proven. Pass/fail limits always come from the Atlas rules.
score_definition: Similarity, 0-1. Each square is compared with the target's squares: d = weighted distance after scaling every measurement by Earth's typical spread (1 unit = one interquartile range); similarity = exp(-d). Score = 0.5 x (the 75% percentile of the site's square similarities, each vs its 5 nearest target squares) + 0.5 x (average over target squares of exp(-distance to the site's closest square)). 1.0 = identical to the target on every weighted measurement. No Earth site gets close to the lunar south pole (steeper than any site), so about 0.6 is a strong match. NOT on the same scale as rule scores.
score_comparability: Compare scores within one test/target set only: each set has its own target, weights and Earth scaling, so 0.5 in one set is not 0.5 in another. score_percentile (0-100) = share of the other sites analysed in the same set that this site out-scores.
confidence_definition: Stability, not certainty: confidence = stable_runs / total_runs. A run is one small change (see small_change_definition); 'stable' = the site's rank moved by at most max(1, 5% of the sites ranked) places. 100% = stable in every run. uncertainty = 1 - confidence. Suggested label: 'Stable in 14/14 runs'.
small_change_definition: One change at a time: each weighted measurement's weight x1.2 and x0.8 (2 runs per measurement), pixels 2x bigger (Moon 100 m -> 200 m, Mars 500 m -> 1000 m), and the square grid shifted by half a square. total_runs = 2 x (weighted measurements) + 2 = 10 or 12 or 14 (it depends on how many measurements the mission weighs). Not the same as the website's +/-30% x 30 weight jitter.
low_evidence_rule: low_evidence = true when the site has fewer than 6 usable squares (Moon: 5 km, under 150 km2; Mars: 20 km, under 2400 km2; left after removing squares with missing data or over a land-cover limit): a lead to check, not a recommendation.
aggregation: Several sites in one cell: keep the highest score (--agg max), as the importer does.
